commitResults.messageTitle: add read and write from file

commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a TaskList class to own the in-memory task collection and common operations such as add, remove, lookup, size checks, and date filtering.

Update Kong to depend on TaskList instead of passing a raw ArrayList through command handling. This keeps parsing and UI behavior unchanged while moving the code one small step toward the intended OO structure.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Move command-line splitting, deadline parsing, event parsing, and date parsing into a Parser class so Kong can focus on coordinating commands against the task list and storage.

Keep the existing command behavior and error messages unchanged. The parser currently returns small structured value objects for parsed commands, deadlines, and events; task-number validation remains in Kong because those messages are tied to command execution.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Introduce a Ui class for user-facing console interactions such as the welcome banner, separators, error messages, task lists, date-filtered lists, deletion confirmation, loading errors, and goodbye output.

Update Kong to delegate printing to Ui while keeping command execution and all existing console text unchanged. This moves the program closer to the intended separation where Kong coordinates Parser, TaskList, Storage, and Ui.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Give Storage a constructor that accepts the task file path and convert load/save from static methods to instance methods that use that path.

Reshape Kong into an application object with Ui, Storage, and TaskList fields. main now creates new Kong("data/duke.txt").run(), which matches the target OOP structure while preserving all console behavior and the existing data file location.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Move the larger switch branch bodies in Kong into small private helper methods for todo, deadline, event, on-date listing, mark, unmark, and delete commands.

Keep command execution in Kong for now, but make the run loop read as command dispatch instead of detailed task manipulation. Existing console output and validation behavior are preserved, including the current delete non-number error text.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Remove direct console output from task constructors and mark/unmark overrides so task classes focus on task state and formatting.

Have Kong call Ui after adding, marking, and unmarking tasks. This keeps the existing console transcript unchanged while making Ui the single place for user-facing interaction messages.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Rename the existing command-word enum role to CommandType so the project can use Command as the abstract base class requested by the stretch goal.

Introduce an abstract Command class with execute(tasks, ui, storage) and a default isExit() method. Kong still dispatches using the existing switch for this increment, so behavior remains unchanged while the command-object path is opened.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add ListCommand, ExitCommand, and UnknownCommand as concrete subclasses of the new abstract Command class.

Update Kong to execute these simple command objects while leaving the more argument-heavy commands on the existing helper path for now. This moves command execution toward the stretch-goal design in a low-risk increment.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add TodoCommand, DeadlineCommand, and EventCommand to own the execution of adding new tasks, showing the added-task message, and saving through Storage.

Move shared storage save error handling into the abstract Command base class so write commands can persist changes consistently. Kong now creates and executes these add commands while preserving the existing parser validation and console behavior.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add MarkCommand, UnmarkCommand, and DeleteCommand to own task-number parsing, task lookup or removal, UI confirmation, and saving.

Move shared task-index parsing and invalid-number error creation into the abstract Command base class. Kong now delegates mark, unmark, and delete execution to command objects while preserving the current messages.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add OnDateCommand to own the execution of listing deadlines and events that occur on a parsed date.

Update Kong to create and execute OnDateCommand after preserving the existing empty-argument and invalid-date validation behavior.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Move command-object creation from Kong into Parser so Parser.parse now returns an executable Command for each supported command word.

Simplify Kong.run to parse one command, execute it, and check command.isExit(). This completes the main command-object handoff while preserving existing console behavior and validation messages.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add Ui.readCommand() so console input is handled by the UI class instead of Kong creating its own Scanner.

Reshape Kong.run around a boolean isExit loop that parses a full command, executes it, and stores command.isExit(). The divider timing is kept unchanged so the console transcript remains stable.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

commitResults.messageTitle: Align run loop with command objects
commitResults.messageBody:
Update Kong.run to follow the stretch-goal command-object flow: read a full command through Ui, show the divider, parse an executable Command, execute it with TaskList, Ui, and Storage, record command.isExit(), and show the divider from a finally block.

Remove the now-unnecessary executeCommand helper because the run loop can call command.execute directly. Add a UI test-plan case for the final divider after the exit command, since divider timing now intentionally follows the stretch-goal structure.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Move classes under the kong package hierarchy while keeping src/main/java as the source root. Group command objects, parser helpers, storage, task model classes, UI, and exceptions into responsibility-based packages.

Add package declarations and imports throughout the Java sources. Update the UI test runner to compile Java files recursively and launch kong.Kong after the package move.

UI tests: python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

Add Gradle settings and an application build for the packaged Kong project, keeping src/main/java as the source root and configuring kong.Kong as the main class.

Configure Java 25 toolchains for compilation and wire the run task to use standard input so the console chatbot works through ./gradlew run.

Add the Gradle 9.7.1 wrapper so the project can be built without a separately installed Gradle.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit test for Event date matching
commitResults.messageBody:
Configure Gradle to run JUnit Jupiter tests on the JUnit Platform and add EventTest under the matching kong.task package path.

Cover Event.occursOn across multi-day and one-day event boundaries so dates before, within, and after an event range are verified.

Validation: env GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/gradle-user-home ./gradlew test; python3 .codex/skills/test-ui/scripts/run_ui_tests.py

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand JUnit coverage for core task workflows
commitResults.messageBody:
Add focused JUnit coverage for command parsing, task-list date filtering and mutation, storage loading and persistence, and Event display/file formats. Cover valid behavior alongside malformed inputs and date boundaries to protect user-facing task behavior and saved data.

Document the project target of testing roughly the highest-value 50% of methods and require JUnit test updates after every code change.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with SE-EDU standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Java sources and tests use inconsistent acronym, boolean, and test
method naming. Several lines also exceed the project's width limit.

Rename identifiers and the Todo source file, wrap long expressions,
and document public APIs so the code follows one consistent standard.

Java changes need a shared project-specific interpretation of the
SE-EDU basic and intermediate coding conventions.

Add a reusable skill and require agents to apply it to production and
test Java code so future edits follow the same rules.

Commit messages and branch names need a shared project convention so
future history remains concise and easy to review.

Add a reusable Git skill and require agents to apply it before
proposing or creating commits while preserving explicit authorization.

Users need a quick way to locate tasks without scanning the entire
list.

Add a case-insensitive find command that searches task descriptions,
preserves list order, and reports empty or unsuccessful searches.
